Raid Helper
shared for the whole guild
ℹ Saved for everyone the moment you click Save below (not just this browser) - set this once, not per-person.
Right-click your server name in Discord → Copy Server ID (requires Developer Mode).
Without this, you paste an event URL manually. With it, events auto-load.
Hand Off GM
ℹ Makes them GM and makes you an Officer instead - you keep your access, you just stop being GM. If you leave the guild afterward as the only GM, the longest-serving Officer becomes GM automatically.
Danger Zone
⚠ Deleting this guild removes its roster, raids, strats, and every member's access — permanently, for everyone. This does not touch Discord (no channels or messages are deleted). This cannot be undone.
